question: A 30-year-old primigravida lady comes to the clinic for her antenatal checkup with an ultrasound scan showing 28 weeks of pregnancy with breech presentation. She is concerned about this and wants to know about the incidence of breech at term. Which of the following is correct about the incidence of breech presentation at term?

A 32-year-old para 1+0 woman has severe postpartum hemorrhage due to placenta previa that is not responding to therapy. The obstetrician says that surgical management is now needed. The patient plans on bearing children in the future. Which of the following is most appropriate and effective to achieve therapeutic goals in this patient?

A 40-year-old gravida 1 para 0+0 lady comes during her 10th gestational week for screening for Down's syndrome. Which of the following is the best screening test recommended for Down's syndrome in the first trimester?
A primigravida at 26 weeks of gestation is advised for cordocentesis. Which of the following is the most common reason for performing cordocentesis?

A 24-year-old primigravida lady comes to the clinic during her 10th gestational week. She has previously been diagnosed with Epilepsy and takes medications to manage her symptoms. Which of the following anti-epileptics is considered safe in pregnancy?

A 28-year-old gravida 2 para 1+0 woman came to the antenatal clinic during her 26th gestational week with complaints of fever, burning micturition and lower back pain. On examination, her blood pressure was 110/70 mmHg, and her heart rate was 110 beats per minute. She was diagnosed with a urinary tract infection (UTI) and started on antibiotics. Which of the following organisms is the most common cause of UTIs during pregnancy?
Which of the following is an accurate description of the shape of the posterior fontanelle?

A 24-year-old primigravida comes to the clinic 2 weeks after delivering a healthy baby girl. She complains of high-grade fever and breast tenderness for 4 days. On examination, her left breast is engorged and tender. She is diagnosed with mastitis and is prescribed antibiotics. Which of the following antibiotics is routinely prescribed to treat this condition?

A 34-year-old multigravida woman came to the clinic 2 weeks after giving birth with complaints of breast tenderness. On examination, she had tachycardia, her temperature was 101 °F (38 °C), and her left breast was engorged, erythematous, and tender. An ultrasound was advised which showed a breast abscess. Which of the following is an appropriate treatment option for this patient?

answers.option: Advise regular breast massage and ask to wait for spontaneous resolution
Prescribe NSAIDs and advise the use of icepacks
Surgical incision and drainage along with antibiotics

question: Chorion villus sampling (CVS) is an invasive prenatal diagnostic test usually performed by passing a needle through the abdominal wall to the developing placenta under ultrasound guidance. It can also be performed by passing a fine catheter through the cervix into the placenta. Which of the following is the minimum gestational age after which this procedure should be performed?

In the case of Rh incompatibility where the fetus is too premature to be safely delivered, fetal blood transfusion is considered with the aim of restoring hemoglobin levels and preventing hydrops. Which of the following is an appropriate site for this transfusion?

A 22-year-old woman comes to the clinic 2 weeks after giving birth to a healthy baby girl with complaints of feeling agitated and angry, being unable to sleep, and having frequent episodes of crying for no apparent reason. Which of the following is an appropriate diagnosis for this patient?

A 32-year-old multigravida woman came to the clinic 4 days after giving birth with complaints of breast tenderness. On examination, her right breast is engorged and edematous. Which of the following will help in alleviating her pain?

A 33-year-old primigravida woman is being planned for delivery with a ventouse cup after prolonged labor. For successful use of the ventouse, it is important to correctly determine the flexion point. Which of the following correctly describes this flexion point?

answers.option: 3 cm anterior to the anterior fontanelle
6 cm anterior to the posterior fontanelle
3 cm anterior to the posterior fontanelle

question: A 23-year-old primigravida comes to the labor room in her 39th gestational week with complaints of labor pains. She says that her contractions started 2 hours ago and have been increasing in intensity since then. On examination, the fetal lie was longitudinal, and soft irregular parts were felt on vaginal examination. Which of the following correctly describes the presentation of the fetus?

A 25-year-old primigravida comes to the antenatal in her 30th gestational week with complaints of the absence of fetal movements. Which of the following is the best test to confirm intrauterine death?
When can chorionicity be checked on ultrasound in multiple pregnancies?
Which of the following correctly describes the steps that take place in labor?

answers.option: Engagement, descent, flexion, external rotation, restitution, extension, internal rotation
Engagement, descent, flexion, internal rotation, extension, restitution, external rotation
Engagement, flexion, internal rotation, descent, restitution, extension, external rotation
Engagement, descent, extension, internal rotation, flexion, restitution, external rotation
Engagement, descent, external rotation, flexion, extension, restitution, internal rotation

question: Which of the following is an appropriate test to diagnose thalassemia in the antenatal period?

A 36-year-old multigravida comes to the emergency department during her 3rd trimester with complaints of dyspnea, hemoptysis, and unilateral calf pain. On examination, she has a temperature of 101.4 F (38.5 °C) and there is a swelling on her left calf. The obstetrician on-call suspects a deep vein thrombosis (DVT). Which of the following is an appropriate test to check for DVTs following clinical suspicion?

A 25-year-old primigravida woman comes to the antenatal clinic during her third trimester. She is unsure of her gestational age. She has previously been to the general physician and had ultrasound scans done in her 6th, 10th, and 28th week. Which of the following will appropriately help determine her gestational age?

A 24-year-old primigravida was rushed to the emergency department during her third trimester in a collapsed state. Her GCS was found to be 8. Which of the following is an appropriate immediate management option for the patient?
Which of the following statements correctly describes perinatal death?

answers.option: a baby born with no signs of life
stillbirth > 24 weeks of gestation or death within 14 days of birth
stillbirth > 24 weeks of gestation or death within 7 days of birth
